text:
michael: Heads-up — a few invoice previews jumped ~2x for some customers around 12:11 UTC, looks bursty and correlated with edge-proxy backpressure. Anyone else seeing this?

lisa: Yep. I saw the same. sidecar was queuing and then we got a flood of metering events when it drained. logs attached in thread.

sam: Is this the same duplicate-fingerprint problem or a new flavor? Did route fallback flip recently?

michael: deploy-bot applied ingress v3.2.1 at ~12:08, but patched config for retry/backoff. fallback didn't change AFAIK. The duplicate events have same client_id & prompt_hash but different route_tag.

ashley: Billing here — duplicates are creating preview spikes but they dedupe in final invoice so not charging yet. However previews are scaring customers. Our current dedupe window is 5m and uses event_id + fingerprint. Because route_tag differs, dedupe misses.

sam: Proposed quick fix: canonicalize route_tag for metering events (map aliases -> canonical route_id) before dedupe, and increase dedupe window to 10m for fallback cases. Also add a checksum over (client_id + prompt_hash) as primary fingerprint.

lisa: I'd add a time-bucketing debouncing too: floor(ts / 600) as part of dedupe key so a flurry within the same 10m bucket collapses. That avoids cross-window drift. Example: `dedupe_key = sha256(client_id||prompt_hash) + ':' + floor(ts/600)`.

ashley: Good. Also we should emit a metric `metering.duplicate_events.count` with tag fallback=true/false and surface it on the console as a small alert (Severity: P3). Customers seeing preview noise can be messaged after we finish backfill.

michael: I'll open a canary PR with canonicalization + 10m bucket + feature flag. Canary to 20% tenants and wire the metric. @sam can you review? :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to cluster-canary-2 (michael/canonicalize-metering vPR-482)

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-1023 to track affected preview emails and backfill plan.

michael: Plan for next steps: 1) Canaried change, 2) monitor `metering.duplicate_events.count`, 3) if stable, roll to all, 4) run backfill to collapse duplicates in previews and mark invoices as unchanged. Will coordinate with @ashley on messaging.

lisa: I'll add a dashboard panel in the console for duplicates by tenant and route_alias, and a short runbook for oncall.

sam: Sounds good. If we see more variants we can switch to idempotency token propagation from edge -> metering to make the dedupe airtight.

michael: Thanks team — keeping this thread for rollout notes and results.
